interests: Supernatural thrillers featuring a team of brothers or partners hunting supernatural entities like ghosts, demons, and angels, set against the backdrop of hidden bunkers filled with classified bestiaries and ancient lore.

Hard science fiction exploring controversial scientific theories such as climate shifts caused by solar activity or continental drift, focusing on protagonists who challenge established academic institutions despite facing ridicule and professional termination.

Space opera adventures involving bounty hunters navigating galactic politics, utilizing advanced technology like repulsorlifts, and engaging in high-stakes conflicts across rocky wastes and floating throne rooms.
